pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with rounded, smooth edge gradients on the flank. Patches exhibit high spatial area relative to the width of the separating corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream pathways. Junction nodes consist of both tri-radial and four-way intersections. Corridor pixel thickness is consistent across the central flank region.
